title: Viumo 1.1.6 — Bigger, Sleeker & Powered by You! 🔥🚀

blocks.content:
Dear Viumo Family,

We’ve been working behind the scenes to bring you our biggest and slickest release yet! Version 1.1.6 is officially live, loaded with fresh titles, powerful new controls, and a complete makeover.

Here’s what’s waiting for you inside:

• Next-Level Player UI 🎬: A brand-new, ultra-sleek player interface designed for smoother controls, faster response, and a true cinematic experience.
• Unlocked Content & Smarter Search 🔍: We’ve opened up our library! Stream and download previously unavailable titles, and find your favorite movies faster than ever with our upgraded search engine.
• Power-User Settings ⚡: Did you know you can unlock up to 5 simultaneous downloads? Head to Settings under your Profile to boost your download limits and turn on Auto-Delete to clean up completed movies effortlessly.
• Account Safety & Recovery 🔐: Enjoy total peace of mind with instant email/password recovery and full control over your account management.
• Rock-Solid Stability 🛠️: We squashed the pesky bugs and crashes to make sure your streaming stays buttery smooth.

Love the new look and features? Don’t keep Viumo a secret! Share the app with your friends, binge together, and keep telling us what you’d like to see next.

Update now, jump in, and happy streaming! 🍿
